def z_to_widths(self, z):
        """softmax parameterization: strictly feasible widths, sum = 1."""
        z = np.asarray(z, dtype=float)
        ez = np.exp(z - np.max(z))
        sm = ez / np.sum(ez)
        return (1.0 - self.nb * 1e-7) * sm + 1e-7
